# Sam Vllaco

> Sam Vllaco (Samir Vllaco) is a product designer based in Tirana, Albania, with 10 years of experience designing SaaS, AI, fintech, health and e-commerce products for teams in the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and the UAE. He works alone, from the first call to handover, and can build the front end too.

## Hire Sam
- [Book a 30-minute call](https://samvllaco.com/book/): talk through your product and leave with a scope, a timeline and one next step.
- [Services](https://samvllaco.com/services/): SaaS product design, dashboards, AI product UX, mobile app design, UX audits, design systems, websites, landing pages, branding and SEO.
- Email: hello@samvllaco.com

## Work
- [Case studies](https://samvllaco.com/work/): dashboards, web apps, mobile apps and marketing sites.

## Products
- [27 Copy-Paste Prompts to Fix AI Slop UI](https://samvllaco.com/ebook/): an ebook for founders who built an app with Claude, Cursor, Lovable or v0 and want it to look designed. Includes a DESIGN.md rules file and a private video. $6.99.
